name_en: 费尔南多/西班牙/伊莎贝拉/统一/宗教裁判/哥伦布/大航海
description_zh: 西班牙统一/宗教裁判/新世界发现/美洲殖民/大航海时代/天主教王后
description_en: Ferdinand II of Aragon and Isabella I of Castile unified Spain through marriage in 1469, establishing the Spanish Empire. Their joint reign oversaw the completion of the Reconquista in 1492, expulsion of Jews and Muslims, funding of Columbus' voyages, and the beginning of Spanish colonization in the Americas. This created the foundation for Spain's golden age and global empire.
